newsitem.title: UK: UK card spending up 19.7 pct yr/yr in April - CCRG.
newsitem.headline: UK card spending up 19.7 pct yr/yr in April - CCRG.

text.p: The Credit Card Research Group, representing major UK credit and debit card issuers, released the following consumer spending figures for April 1996 -
CARD EXPENDITURE (in mln stg) * APRIL APRIL 96 % change
NOTE * figures adjusted for variations in the number of processing days between months.
Credit Card Research Group director Elizabeth Phillips said credit and debit card spending rose above eight billion stg in April for the first time outside the Christmas period.
With credit card spending climbing to 4.4 billion stg, the figures indicate some cardholders may be buying now in anticipation of building society windfall payments, she said.

"These are the first figures published each month which record actual spending by consumers as opposed to estimates grossed up from a sample," Phillips said. "Now that card payments account for a third of high street expenditure they are a good indication of consumer trends."
